name: Speaker 8 Ω 0.5 W (20 mm round)
description: Small round 20 mm speaker for voice in tight cases (an egg, a keychain): a bit quieter than the 28 mm one but clear for speech. Drive it from an amplifier, such as the DFPlayer Mini's SPK_1 (+) and SPK_2 (-); never straight from a board pin (8 Ω would pull 600 mA).

pins.description: Speaker lead +. To the amplifier output + (DFPlayer SPK_1).
Speaker lead -. To the amplifier output - (DFPlayer SPK_2, which is not ground).

props.label: Impedance
props.description: Coil impedance. The DFPlayer drives 4 or 8 Ω; 8 Ω is quieter but kinder to a battery.

props.label: Rated power
props.description: What the speaker takes continuously before it distorts or burns.

footprint: 20 mm round frame, two solder pads (wires)

bindings.description: Something plays through it (more than 1 mW).
Electrical power into the coil (W, RMS).
RMS voltage across the leads (+ minus -).

mechanical.source: typical 20 mm 8 Ω 0.5 W mylar micro speaker, 4 mm deep (often sold as 2004 / 20 x 4 mm)

sourcing.package: 20 mm round, 4 mm deep, solder pads
sourcing.generic: Micro speaker 20 mm, 8 Ω, 0.5 W (mylar cone)
